screening_answers.question: Describe a RAG system or agent you built end to end.
screening_answers.answer: site-to-agent turns any website into a grounded chat agent: crawler, hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval fused with RRF on pgvector, cited answers, SSRF-hardened fetching and an eval harness for answer quality. multi-agent-research-crew adds planner, researcher, writer and verifier agents on a custom DAG orchestrator with retries, timeouts, token budgets and claim-level citation checks.

screening_answers.question: How do you control hallucinations and add guardrails?
screening_answers.answer: Ground answers in retrieved sources and require citations. In PageForge, AI drafts only from approved facts, a deterministic validator flags unsupported numbers, and a reviewer signs off claim by claim. contractor-ai-ops-dashboard uses number-checked AI summaries. I also add evals and prompt-injection defences.

screening_answers.question: Do you have experience with voice AI, WhatsApp agents or OCR?
screening_answers.answer: Not in production. I built ai-lead-receptionist, a Claude agent over Twilio SMS and web chat that qualifies leads and books jobs, so telephony, conversational flows and webhooks are familiar. I have not built STT/TTS, WhatsApp or OCR pipelines yet and would ramp up on them quickly.

screening_answers.question: What is your notice period / when can you start?
screening_answers.answer: Immediate. My previous role ended in Sep 2026, and I am based in Pune, so I can work on-site.

screening_answers.question: What are your salary expectations?
screening_answers.answer: I am targeting INR 30,000 per month or more, and I am flexible on structure. What matters to me is the total package and the work. I would like to discuss the range for this role.

needs_you: Decide how to frame the voice, WhatsApp and OCR gap in an interview.
knockout_warnings: Voice AI, WhatsApp and OCR experience is not on the CV; do not claim it.
Salary range is not stated in the posting.

paragraphs: I am applying for the AI Engineer (Agentic & Generative AI) role. I am based in Pune and available immediately. I have 3 years of professional full-stack experience at a US-based medical-device company, where I built AI agents for internal use, a CRM and other apps.

Your posting asks for agents and RAG built end to end. site-to-agent is a grounded chat agent with hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval on pgvector, cited answers and an eval harness. multi-agent-research-crew runs tool-calling agents on a custom DAG orchestrator with retries, token budgets and claim-level citation checks. Both are in Python, with FastAPI and Claude or Gemini APIs elsewhere in my work. I use Claude Code daily and hold CCDV-F and CCAO-F.

I have not yet built voice, WhatsApp or OCR pipelines. ai-lead-receptionist (Twilio SMS and web chat, Claude, Supabase) covers the telephony and webhook side, and I would learn the rest quickly. My portfolio is at hussain-singapuri.vercel.app. I would welcome a conversation.
